verdict.rationale: Docs show delete() operations and manual/incremental reindexing via optimize() to update vector/FTS indexes after data changes (docs-8, docs-23, docs-33), suggesting some support for continuous data changes, but there is no explicit documentation of an upsert/merge operation or of freshness/consistency semantics (e.g., how quickly new/deleted rows appear in search before reindexing, staleness windows, or consistency guarantees). missing for 10: explicit upsert/merge_insert API docs, documented consistency/freshness guarantees for search after writes, benchmarks or hands-on confirmation of update latency.
